build: slender with defined shoulders from years of studio work
hair: dark brown, almost black, thick and wavy, worn long past her shoulders or twisted into a loose knot when she's concentrating
complexion: warm olive undertone with a small beauty mark high on her left cheekbone
face: a face that broadcasts feeling—wide-set dark eyes that go soft when she's listening, a full mouth quick to curve or tighten, high cheekbones that catch light and shadow in ways that make her expressions flicker across her features like weather
signature_feature: her hands—long-fingered, always slightly paint-stained or marked from her work, moving expressively when she talks, capable and restless
second_celebrated_feature: the small scar along her right collarbone from a childhood accident, which she never hides and which somehow makes her look more real, more lived-in
signature_habits: she hums while working—old Persian lullabies her grandmother taught her, half-remembered; she touches her collarbone scar unconsciously when she's anxious; she keeps a worn leather notebook filled with design sketches and half-formed thoughts; she makes tea the traditional way, insisting on loose leaves and patience
occupation: textile and interior designer, owner of a small independent studio in the city where she takes on bespoke commissions for high-net-worth clients

current_crisis.event: a major client—a billionaire investor—has commissioned a complete redesign of his penthouse and is now threatening to pull the contract and publicly claim her work is derivative after she refused his advances at a private meeting
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: panic mixed with a hot, sick shame that she somehow invited this
current_crisis.immediate_want: to prove her work is original and to make him retract the accusation before it destroys her reputation and her studio

wound.core: she believes that if she is not useful, if she cannot create something beautiful and valuable, she is invisible—unworthy of taking up space
wound.surfacing_hint: when criticized or rejected, she goes very quiet and still, her hands stopping mid-gesture, her eyes going distant as if she's already erasing herself
